module.vision.label: Vision
vision.title: Vision
vision.description: Every image of the set, filtered and sorted by what the import measured. Open one for its details; decide what models should leave out.
vision.notImages: This dataset is a table, not an image set. Vision opens image sets: a folder, a ZIP or a Parquet file of images imported from Home.
vision.importing: The images are still being imported
vision.tab.mapHint: Coming: the images as a map of points, close when they look alike, with clusters and a lasso that filters the gallery.
vision.tab.prepareHint: Coming: resizing, cropping and colour steps, each shown before and after on sample images.
vision.tab.modelHint: Coming: the task read from the labels, and a baseline model trained when you ask.
vision.tab.resultsHint: Coming: every metric, the confusion matrix and the images the model gets wrong.
vision.tab.explainHint: Coming: why the model decides, from its own evidence first (nearest examples, prototypes), then heatmaps with their caveats.
vision.stats.title: Dataset stats
vision.stats.sampled: {count} images: an even sample of 5,000 is drawn.
vision.stats.sentence.measure: Median {median}; the middle half lies between {low} and {high}.
vision.stats.sentence.sharpness: Median {median}; no image under 100, the usual blur threshold.
vision.stats.sentence.sharpnessLow: Median {median}; {count} images under 100, the usual blur threshold.
vision.stats.sharpnessTip: Sharpness is the variance of the Laplacian at 512 pixels: it spreads over several orders of magnitude, so the axis is logarithmic. Under 100 a photo usually looks blurry; R-VQ-04 also asks that it be far below this set's own sharpness.
vision.stats.balanced: Classes are balanced: {largest} has {ratio}× the images of {smallest}.
vision.stats.oneLabel: A single label: nothing to tell apart yet.
vision.stats.clickHint: Click a bar to show only those images in the gallery.
vision.gallery.keys: Click to select, Shift or Ctrl to add, drag a rectangle to select several. Enter or a double click opens an image. E excludes, K keeps, R goes back to the rules.
vision.sort.name: Name
vision.sort.label: Label
vision.field.label: Label
vision.sheet.excludedByYou: Left out of models by your decision.
vision.sheet.keptByYou: Kept by your decision, though a rule would leave it out.
vision.sheet.location: The file holds location data. It is never read nor shown (R-IMG-05).
vision.sheet.notDecoded: This file could not be decoded (R-VQ-01): it is listed, never used by models.
vision.sheet.notShown: Not in the gallery's current filters
vision.viewer.failed: The original could not be shown by the browser (its format, such as TIFF, may not be supported). Its measures were taken at the import.
vision.decisions.label: Your decisions
vision.decisions.explain: Nothing is deleted: an excluded image stays in the table, left out of models.
vision.decisions.saved: Saved as version {version}: {excluded} images left out of models.
vision.quality.notRun: The quality rules did not run for this set.
vision.quality.totals: {flagged} images flagged by a rule; {excluded} left out of models, your decisions included.
vision.quality.metric: Main metric for models: balanced accuracy (R-VQ-13).
vision.quality.duplicatesHelp: Exact copies (R-VQ-09) keep their first image; near copies (R-VQ-10) are only flagged. Choose the copy to keep: the others are left out of models.
vision.quality.moreCopies: and {count} more copies in this group: open one to see them all
vision.quality.reading: How the set was read ({count} rules)
